newsitem.title: USA: MOST IMM CURRENCY FUTURES END LACKLUSTER DAY LOWER.
newsitem.headline: MOST IMM CURRENCY FUTURES END LACKLUSTER DAY LOWER.

text.p: Aug 11 - Most IMM currency futures ended a lackluster day lower. Sept yen and marks are expected to fall further in the near term. Traders said positive dollar fundamentals remain intact. Sterling and Mexican pesos finished firmer, while Can dollars remained hamstrung below support at $0.7196. ((Chicago Derivatives Desk (312)408-8750))
